Name: Flower Fence for Alternative Textures
Author: NaoeaDri
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z5GvUWW.png[/img]

1. Download [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
2. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
3. Download this mod and unzip in your mods folder
4. Run the game using SMAPI


[img]https://i.imgur.com/qNUCQdz.png[/img]

Turn fences into flowers with Alternative Textures for decorative purposes.
This mod contains skins of the following flowers:
Tulip (in 5 colors);
Blue Jazz (in 6 colors);
Summer Spangle (in 6 colors);
Poppy (in 3 colors);
Sunflower;
Fairy Rose (in 6 colors).

There is also a file to make the gravel path into hoe dirt in the main files.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/Q59xhyP.png[/img]

To use the mod, you'll first need the Paint Bucket which is sold at Robin's Carpentry Shop, along with the other tools from the Alternative Textures mod. Then all you have to do is click with the paint bucket on Wood Fences which you want to turn into a flower, and then a menu will appear with all the options for you to choose from, just click on what you like the most and the job is done.
